_comment: Mechanical Engineering problems (real-world problems, never one student's project). IDs must be unique across all problem files.

problems.title: Small workshops lack affordable machine tools
problems.description: Local fabricators and small workshops still bend, cut, thread and press metal, wood and pipe by hand because imported machine tools are expensive. Simple, locally made machines raise output, accuracy and safety.

problems.title: Manual farm work limits small farmers' output
problems.description: Most small farmers plant, weed and prepare land by hand, which limits how much they can grow and how fast. Low-cost, locally made machines for planting, weeding and field work raise yields and reduce drudgery.

problems.title: Heavy lifting and loading done by hand
problems.description: Goods, equipment and materials are often lifted, loaded and carried by hand, which is slow and causes injuries. Simple lifts, trolleys, hoists and loaders make handling safer and faster.

problems.title: Slow, labour-intensive building work
problems.description: Bricks, blocks and pavers are made by hand and sites are mixed, plastered and cleared manually, which is slow, costly and tiring. Simple construction machines raise output and quality for small builders.

problems.title: Vehicle and machine maintenance done with improvised tools
problems.description: Garages and transport operators often service tyres, brakes, engines and rolling stock with improvised tools, which is slow and unsafe. Purpose-built service equipment makes maintenance faster, safer and more reliable.

problems.title: Cleaning done by hand in homes, workplaces and public spaces
problems.description: Floors, dishes, clothes, shoes and public spaces are mostly cleaned by hand, which takes time and exposes workers to dirt and chemicals. Low-cost cleaning machines save labour and water.

problems.title: Small producers lack affordable processing machines
problems.description: Small factories and home businesses mix, fill, cap and package products by hand, limiting how much they can sell. Affordable, locally made production machines help them grow.
